name: sirius-ai
description: Multi-model AI for Sirius IDE — Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama and eight more providers behind the editor's own chat, agent mode and inline chat. Thinking, native tool calling, image input for vision models, Tab completion, next-edit prediction.

sirius.ai.ollama.endpoint.markdownDescription: Where Sirius looks for Ollama when nothing is configured — chat models and Tab completion. Another Ollama host can be added in **Manage Models**.

sirius.ai.thinking.enabled.description: Enable thinking/reasoning mode for supported models (Claude Opus, Sonnet, Gemini 3.5)

enumDescriptions: Extra high — best for coding and agentic work
Max — maximum depth, when correctness beats cost
sirius.ai.thinking.effort.description: How deeply the AI should reason before responding

sirius.ai.temperature.description: AI response creativity (0 = deterministic, 2 = very creative)

sirius.ai.streamResponses.description: Stream AI responses token by token

sirius.ai.enable.markdownDescription: Tab completion, per language. `"*"` is the default for every language; a language id such as `"markdown"` or `"json"` overrides it. This is the switch the chat status dashboard toggles. Completions need a local FIM model — Ollama or llama.cpp; see `#sirius.ai.completions.model#`.

sirius.ai.inlineCompletions.deprecationMessage: Use sirius.ai.enable — it is per language and is what the chat status dashboard toggles. true here still turns completions on everywhere.

sirius.ai.openai.baseUrl.description: Override the OpenAI endpoint — e.g. an Azure deployment or a corporate proxy.
sirius.ai.openai.baseUrl.markdownDeprecationMessage: Set in **Manage Models**: OpenAI's Base URL is part of the provider now. An earlier value moved there on the first start of 1.118.12.

sirius.ai.lmstudio.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Where Sirius looks for LM Studio when nothing is configured. Another server can be added in **Manage Models**.

sirius.ai.llamacpp.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Where Sirius looks for llama-server or vLLM when nothing is configured — chat models and Tab completion. Another server can be added in **Manage Models**.

sirius.ai.custom.baseUrl.description: Base URL of any other OpenAI-compatible service, including the /v1 suffix.
sirius.ai.custom.baseUrl.markdownDeprecationMessage: Add the server in **Manage Models** (OpenAI-compatible, custom), where it can have a name and a key. An earlier value moved there on the first start of 1.118.12.

sirius.ai.completions.model.description: Model for Tab completion: "auto" picks a running Ollama code model automatically; or "ollama/<model>"; or "llamacpp" for the configured llama.cpp server.

sirius.ai.completions.maxLines.description: Longest suggestion Tab completion will offer, in lines.

sirius.ai.ollama.largeModelBytes.description: Refuse to load Ollama models larger than this many bytes — protection against freezing the machine with a model that far exceeds its memory. 0 disables the check.

sirius.ai.nextEditSuggestions.enabled.description: Predict your next edit after each change and offer it as a Tab-able diff (experimental; needs a local FIM model). Requires Tab completion to be on — see sirius.ai.enable.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Sirius
walkthroughs.description: Connect a model, meet the agent and set Sirius up your way.

steps.title: Connect a model
steps.description:
Sirius works with the model you choose. In **Manage Models**, add Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, Mistral or xAI with your own key — it goes into your system keyring, never into settings.json. Ollama, LM Studio and llama.cpp on their usual ports are found without adding anything.
[Manage Models](command:sirius.ai.manageModels)
[Choose a Model](command:sirius.ai.selectModel)

media.altText: The Language Models editor: the providers to add, and the models each one offers.

steps.title: Ask, Edit or Agent
steps.description:
Open the chat and pick how much Sirius may do. **Ask** reads your code and answers. **Edit** proposes changes you accept or reject, file by file. **Agent** can also run commands, tasks and tests to finish the job.
[Open Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

media.altText: The chat's mode picker offering Agent, Ask and Edit.

steps.title: Change code where it is
steps.description:
Select some code and press Ctrl+I to ask for a change right there. Right-click a selection for Explain, Fix Errors, Write Tests or Refactor.
[Learn More](https://siriuside.com/docs/inline-chat/)

media.altText: Inline chat open over a selected function in the editor.

steps.title: Teach Sirius your project
steps.description:
Write your conventions in `AGENTS.md` at the root of your workspace (or `.siriusrules`, or `.sirius/rules.md`). Sirius reads it with every request, along with the code around your cursor.
[Learn About Rules](https://siriuside.com/docs/rules-and-context/)

media.altText: An AGENTS.md file of project conventions open in the editor.

steps.title: Tab completion, on your machine
steps.description:
Sirius can complete code as you type, using a local code model: Ollama with a coder model, or llama.cpp. It's off until you turn it on.
[Turn On Tab Completion](command:sirius.ai.enableTabCompletion)
[Learn More](https://siriuside.com/docs/tab-and-next-edit/)

media.altText: A grey Tab-completion suggestion continuing the line being typed.

steps.title: Bring your settings
steps.description:
Coming from VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf or VSCodium? Bring over your settings, keybindings, snippets and extensions.
[Import from Another Editor](command:sirius.ai.importFromEditor)

media.altText: The import picker offering settings, keybindings, snippets and extensions.

steps.title: Choose your theme
steps.description:
Sirius Star Dark is ours; every theme on Open VSX works too.
[Browse Color Themes](command:workbench.action.selectTheme)

media.altText: The color theme picker listing light and dark themes, Sirius Star Dark among them.
